hostname.description: The hostname of the bootp client entry.

hardware_type.description: Hardware type (e.g., 'et' for Ethernet, as per bootptab.5).

hardware_address.description: Hardware address (MAC) of the bootp client, prefixed with '01' for Ethernet.

client_ip.description: IP address assigned to the bootp client.

boot_server_address.description: IP address of the boot server (bootpd).

subnet_mask.description: Subnet mask for the client's network.

bootfile.description: Name of the boot file to retrieve via TFTP.

domain_name_servers.description: Comma-separated list of domain name servers.

broadcast_flag.description: Broadcast flag (0 or 1) for the bootp reply.
